reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 22. Nay or No: 18. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 38 (95%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 207 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

These reckless tariffs have hurt Michigan families more than anyone else — over $6,400 in extra costs! @GovWhitmer is right: You deserve to have that money back in your pocket. 
https://t.co/3aKBKosnDc

Taking food off the plates of hungry kids and seniors is cruel and heartless. By adding mountains of paperwork for hardworking families, the Administration is going to kick millions off SNAP (after they already kicked 5 million Americans off food assistance with the Big Ugly Bill).

Local builders are trying to help more families get into affordable homes, but tariffs are driving up the cost of construction. We need to end the tariffs now, so we can build more and lower housing costs. https://t.co/PeC0xZhOQY

Happy Veterans Day to all those who served! 

If you’re a veteran in mid-Michigan struggling to get the benefits or care you deserve, please give our team a call. We’ve helped dozens of former service members cut through the red tape and get real results. It’d be our honor to do the same for you.
🏡 For working families, a house is about more than a roof over your head. It’s about dignity and capturing a part of the American Dream. https://t.co/FlXKCUhQ2S

To everyone heading to the polls today, keep an eye out for an "I Voted" sticker made by mid-Michigan's own Lenore Coil from Swan Valley High School. Shoutout to Lenore — voting has never looked this cool! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/SdSQe4oHXP
Michigan is short nearly 100,000 housing units. Builders like Cyrus in Saginaw are how we close that gap and get more working families into homes they can be proud of. https://t.co/gUNvw2KNU3

We're ranking #Halloween candy, everyone. What goes in YOUR #1 slot? 🍫🍬🎃

Sound off below! ⬇️ https://t.co/s894wG60Wu

What could you do with an extra $5,619 in your pocket? That’s how much tariffs have taken from Michigan families.

Let’s stop the trade wars before they take any more of your hard-earned money. https://t.co/NMkgls0WNm
On #NationalCatDay, I wanted to introduce you to Milo and Juno. https://t.co/YfodKWDVag

📍 Saginaw, MI

$7 diesel is bad for farmers, truckers, and everyone whose costs go up as a result. We need to end the war in Iran. https://t.co/pYkCJVDAU8
https://t.co/XwwUldaKXB
Stupid policymaking in Washington is literally taking candy away from children. It’s time to end the senseless tariffs and the Iran war. https://t.co/DHU39acgeP

It’s wrong to make kids and seniors go to bed hungry, but that’s exactly what the Big Ugly Bill is doing by kicking over 167,000 people off SNAP in Michigan. 

Working families can’t afford these devastating cuts. https://t.co/9A0T95g5C0

People are already losing their health care because of skyrocketing premiums, and next year, $1 trillion in Medicaid cuts will go into effect. 

We have to fix this health care crisis. https://t.co/pVVhzn0miC
Working parents shouldn’t have to choose between taking their kid to the doctor or putting food on the table. https://t.co/XbTfwU9nX2

.@SenatorSlotkin is a patriot, who has sworn an oath to serve multiple times. She called out blatant corruption and she was right to do so. 

It's unacceptable to use the justice system to threaten your political opponents. These continued attacks against her are dangerous, and https://t.co/MP1YuRD6US

Mid-Michigan families have had to pay $834 extra for gas because of the war in Iran. That number is even higher for anyone who drives a truck and relies on diesel. 

It’s past time to stop the war and bring gas prices back down. https://t.co/dEv0azzFmL

Health care costs are skyrocketing again because of bad policies from out-of-touch politicians. We’re fighting alongside @ProtectOurCare so working families don’t have to choose between seeing a doctor and putting food on the table. https://t.co/331lY3fxfw
Head Start ratios make sure teachers can do their jobs well and kids are safe. This Administration is trying to take that and a bunch of other commonsense standards away. https://t.co/XtRkK9JkzH
Americans are sick and tired of insiders cashing in on public service. It’s time to crack down on politicians who care more about helping themselves than serving you. https://t.co/lrlBI9yEGp

We were proud to welcome the @USChamber to Grand Blanc. When we support entrepreneurs who are trying to start or run a business, we’re supporting the shops, restaurants, and companies that make our communities even stronger. https://t.co/RJaHdpnG9U
This Administration is asking Head Start teachers to do more with less. This proposed overhaul will be disastrous for kids, teachers, and working parents. https://t.co/7FXctZrMDb

Parents today are working hard and still struggling to find affordable child care. We sat down at a child care facility in Fenton to talk about our bipartisan bill to cut red tape and lower costs for parents. https://t.co/AfGMKvvnZb

“If I were Pete Hegseth, I’d be worried. It’s certainly something that needs serious consideration, and I hear Democrats, yes, but I also hear some Republicans saying it as well. I think there’s a lot he needs to answer for.”
https://t.co/AtEfj8HJI0
Maybe we should... stop? https://t.co/1z0m9U2yL2
Supporting the next generation of entrepreneurs and job creators is one of the best things we can do to create lasting economic growth. https://t.co/Di1bC9rpLQ

I was honored to receive the Advocate for American Business Award from the @USChamber yesterday in Grand Blanc. It was all the more special to receive it at Great Harvest Bread Company alongside our friends from the Grand Blanc Chamber of Commerce.

If we want to make it easier for businesses to grow, cutting red tape and standing up to some of the chaotic policies in Washington are great places to start.

The Coast Guard is finally restoring 24/7 rescue operations on the Saginaw Bay and Saginaw River. This will make mid-Michigan safer, and it wouldn’t have happened without our community coming together to raise our voices. https://t.co/UfpmqoHk4G

We can’t let mountains of paperwork stop us from giving kids the care they need. We have a bipartisan bill to cut red tape and make sure more families can get affordable child care. https://t.co/j4zvzI2Cvt

Great news: The Saginaw River Coast Guard station will resume FULL operations in 2027! This means faster search-and-rescue operations and less strain on local law enforcement’s resources.

We’ve been pushing for this for over a year. Thank you to every Michigander who spoke up and helped make this happen.

We had so much fun at the K?Onda! Festival in Saginaw this year. K? Onda! always does a great job bringing people together to celebrate Hispanic culture and heritage, anchored by some of the small businesses and organizations that make mid-Michigan so special. https://t.co/429tzdQztz
Parents deserve better than a broken child care system. We have a bipartisan bill to bring down costs and make things easier for families. https://t.co/FYyjyi6Xll

Farmers and truckers across Michigan are getting crushed by skyrocketing diesel prices. Those high prices then get passed on to everyone.

The war in Iran has to end before things get even worse.

https://t.co/JcUsTegajA
It’s wrong for Big Tech to get tax breaks to build data centers while working people struggle. I wrote a bill to fix that. https://t.co/YKYcdniaEh

One year ago, while gathering to worship, parishioners at the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in Grand Blanc suffered an unimaginable terror attack. I join the community in remembering the four victims, extending our prayers to their families and fellow congregants, and standing with the community as we remember the tragedies of that day.

Today, we also honor the heroic first responders who were on the scene in a matter of seconds. The remarkable speed and decision-making of our 911 dispatchers, law enforcement officers, firefighters, and paramedics saved lives.

In the days, weeks, and months since, neighbors have come together to grieve, heal, and find the light under the motto, “Grand Blanc, Better Together.” In the wake of an unimaginable tragedy, the Church and its community have shown us the power of faith and hope. As they break ground tonight, all of mid-Michigan will be behind them with love and support.

Saginaw’s Medical Diamond is growing! The new @CMUniversity facility will mean better education for med students, more good-paying jobs, and better care for local families and seniors. I was proud to support this project that’s going to make downtown Saginaw even stronger. https://t.co/wOnHyibf8I

Flint is getting a new training facility for police and firefighters from across the region. Not only is this going to help first responders stay safe on the job, but it’s going to make our community safer too. https://t.co/3p2C9VZoYb

President Trump is meeting with President Xi tomorrow to talk about AI. Here’s what needs to happen:

As the U.S. competes with China to lead the world on AI, we need protections for people’s jobs, safety, & opportunities.

That only works if it's on a global scale. This summit is the time to be tough on China & establish universal guardrails to protect Americans’ security & pocketbooks.

A little rain couldn’t stop Flint from shining at the pride festival this year! Thank you to Flint Pride for putting on another great event, and to everybody who showed up to say that everyone has a home in mid-Michigan. https://t.co/UJppROuku0

📍Saginaw, MI

Diesel is now over $7 in mid-Michigan. Anyone who drives a truck is getting crushed by these prices, and all because of the war in Iran. https://t.co/VuukNCQVWa https://t.co/wnSENyabyf

We have $3 billion a month for a war in the Middle East nobody asked for, but we don’t have enough for working families to keep their health care and food assistance? That’s completely backwards. https://t.co/AMWkZf3iHO
G'mar Chatimah Tovah to all those observing Yom Kippur. I hope you and your families have a sacred and meaningful fast. https://t.co/hn8x4S70RE

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
